newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Central Banking closes US$50 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Central Banking closes US$50 mln FRCD.

text.p: Central Banking Corp's US$50 million floating rate certificate of deposit issue has been allotted, arranger Sakura Finance Asia said.
The facility has a final maturity of 364 days. It was priced at par to float at 45 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 53 basis points.
Arrangers and lead managers, with US$5 million each, are ING Barings and Sumitomo Finance Asia.
Co-arrangers and co-lead manangers, with US$5 million each, are DBS and WestLB.
Co-lead managers, with US$5 million each, are Bank of Nova Scotia Asia and Bank Austria Aktiengesellschaft, Hong Kong. Co-lead manager Sudwestdeutsche Landesbank Singapore committed US$9 million.

Managers, with US$2 million each, are Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena Singapore, First Commercial Bank, Singapore, SBI European Bank and Union Bank of Switzerland. Manager Berliner Bank Aktiengesellschaft -Bankgesellschaft Berlin Group committed US$3 million.
